Method of Attack: Encrypts victim's files and displays a ransom screen requiring the victim to read two articles before receiving a free decryption key
Deletes encrypted files if the victim does not read the articles before the countdown reaches zero
Connects to a Command & Control server to retrieve the victim's decryption key
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom screen similar to Jigsaw Ransomware
References to articles: Google Security Blog 'Stay safe while browsing' and BleepingComputer's 'Jigsaw Ransomware Decrypted: Will delete your files until you pay the Ransom'
Message box labeled 'Nice Jigsaw' displaying the decryption key
